_comment: InstantID keyframe workflow (ComfyUI API). STRONG face-identity lock — far better than IPAdapter-plus-face for keeping the SAME person across shots. Requires custom node ComfyUI_InstantID (installed) + these models the USER downloads: (1) models/instantid/ip-adapter.bin (InstantX/InstantID ip-adapter.bin, ~1.7GB); (2) models/controlnet/instantid/diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors (InstantX/InstantID ControlNetModel, ~2.5GB); (3) models/insightface/models/antelopev2/ — 5 onnx files (1k3d68, 2d106det, genderage, glintr100, scrfd_10g_bnkps). Placeholders injected by the pipeline: {{CKPT}} {{REF_IMAGE}}(a CLEAN front face, e.g. gpt_anchors/<char>/front.png) {{POS_PROMPT}} {{NEG_PROMPT}} {{SEED}} {{WIDTH}} {{HEIGHT}} {{INSTANTID_WEIGHT}} {{INSTANTID_CN}} {{INSTANTID_NOISE}} {{INSTANTID_START}} {{INSTANTID_END}}. Enable via config keyframe.use_instantid=true. NOTE 2026-06-18: uses ApplyInstantIDAdvanced (not basic ApplyInstantID) so noise can be set to 0.0 — the basic node hardcodes noise=0.35 which randomizes the face embedding and is the #1 cause of identity drift/aging under dramatic lighting. cn_strength (kps ControlNet) is decoupled from ip_weight (face).
